method: walk-forward (rolling-origin) evaluation; every forecast uses only data available at its origin
selection_rule: The method is fixed by the length of the available history (recommended_kind), from the walk-forward evidence on the real series: fewer than 14 observations -> naive; 600 or more -> ridge alone; in between -> mean of seasonal naive, seasonal drift and ridge. The weekly national series has more than 600 points, so ridge is the method of its artefact; the back-test then checks whether that method is also the most accurate one on the 260 origins (policy_equals_best_on_backtest).

weekly_national.policy_reason: 22.7 full seasons of history: the learned model was the most accurate method on all eleven real series with this much history
